title: MobX observables computeds actions reactions and React integration
concepts: MobX models application state as observable values, derives computed values from them, and tracks which consumers read each observable during execution.
When an observable changes, MobX reruns only the dependent computations and reactions. The dependency graph is discovered dynamically from observable reads.
Actions mark state-changing operations and group writes into transactions so reactions do not observe intermediate states. Strict action enforcement can make mutation boundaries explicit.
Computed values are lazy, cached derivations. Reactions are for side effects that synchronize with systems outside the observable model; they should be disposed when no longer needed.
The observer integration subscribes React components to observables read during rendering and triggers updates when those dependencies change.
MobX favors mutable observable models and automatic dependency tracking, while Redux favors explicit action and reducer transitions with immutable state history.

versionNotes.edition: MobX 6 to MobX 7 major transition; latest package snapshot MobX 7.1.7 checked 2026-11-16
items: MobX 7 requires Proxy support and removes the ES5 fallback, configure({ useProxies }), and proxy:false observable options; use MobX 6 when legacy no-Proxy environments must be supported.
MobX 7 removes legacy decorator support; use standard decorators with the required modern transpiler configuration, or use makeObservable/makeAutoObservable without decorators.
MobX 7 is a cleanup major release; the observable/computed/action/reaction mental model remains, while deprecated compatibility APIs and old React binding paths are removed.
MobX 7.1 adds current patch-level behavior changes; check its changelog for small fixes before relying on implementation edge cases.

versionNotes.edition: MobX React bindings 5/10 and React Compiler integration (2026)
items: Current React bindings are mobx-react-lite for function components and mobx-react for class components; MobX 7 release line pairs them with mobx-react-lite 5 and mobx-react 10.

mobx-react-plugin can automatically wrap eligible components with observer and insert the use no memo directive to prevent React Compiler from caching observable reads as stale JSX; its build transform must run before React Compiler.
